name: Bhabhiji
birthday_subtitle: A beautiful soul deserves the most beautiful day

letter.title: A Letter From My Heart
letter.message: You are not just my Bhabhiji, you are a beautiful part of our family and my life. Your love, care, smile, and blessings make every moment special. I feel lucky to have you in my life. May your birthday bring endless happiness, love, laughter, and beautiful memories. Keep smiling always!

memories.title: A Travel Partner
memories.text: Some journeys become special because of the person beside you. As a sister and a bhabhi, you made every trip lighter, happier and full of beautiful memories.

memories.title: A Rakshabandhan
memories.text: You are not just my bhabhi, you are the sister I always wished for. Every Rakshabandhan with you is filled with love, laughter and a bond that never fades.

memories.title: Strength Combo
memories.text: When Navratri comes, devar and bhabhiji hit the garba floor with full strength. No tiredness, only energy, joy and endless dancing - truly an unbeatable combo!

memories.title: A Memory to Remember
memories.text: Some memories stay in our hearts forever, no matter how much time passes.

memories.title: Forever Our Bonding
memories.text: Wishing for many more beautiful memories, happy moments, and smiles together.
